verses.pali: “Saṅkhatārammaṇā, bhikkhave, uppajjanti pāpakā akusalā dhammā, no asaṅkhatārammaṇā.
verses.english: “Bad, unskillful qualities, mendicants, arise with a conditioned basis, not without a conditioned basis.

verses.pali: Tasseva saṅkhatassa pahānā evaṁ te pāpakā akusalā dhammā na hontī”ti.
verses.english: By giving up that conditioned basis, those bad, unskillful qualities do not occur.”
